name: GPT-Realtime-Translate

voice.input_audio: WebSocket: base64 PCM 16-bit at 24 kHz sent as continuous audio; WebRTC: a source media track [openai-guide-translation]
voice.output_audio: Translated audio deltas played as PCM 16-bit on a WebSocket; a remote audio track on WebRTC; transcript deltas for source and target text [openai-guide-translation]
languages: output: 13 languages, set with audio.output.language (the guides read give an example code es)
voice.turn_detection: None: the session streams continuously from the incoming audio, response.create is not used, and the guide says to keep sending audio including silence between phrases [openai-guide-translation]
voice.interruption: Not applicable: the model interprets a stream and does not answer the speaker [openai-guide-translation]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: $0.034 per minute of audio; billed by duration, not by tokens

unknown: voice.voices: the translation guide and model page read name no voice choice
voice.latency: OpenAI says the model keeps pace with the speaker and publishes no figure in the pages read
voice.session_limit: the translation guide read states no session limit
pricing_usd_per_mtok: the unit is a price per minute of audio, not per token
reasoning: the model has no reasoning control
system_card: OpenAI's Deployment Safety Hub lists no system card or model card for this model on 2026-10-03
benchmarks: no independent measurement of translation quality or latency found on 2026-10-03
context_window: Microsoft Foundry lists 32,000 input and 4,096 output tokens for this model; the OpenAI model page lists 16,000 and 2,000, and this card follows OpenAI
